Shared.Unpacking.Pattern has the same flat variable/unpack syntax as Given; Statement retains the expression. Lean checks proof correctness separately. Tooling review checks implementation and finite test coverage, not universal correctness or browser/CDN behavior. Additional context keys identify supporting definitions inspected in those files, not an audit of every proof or line.
